sources.gs_filter_note: Starters need GS>0 on the season pitching line. Without that line the filter is SKIPPED (gs_filter_applied=false) and every folded starter serves with gs=null.

ewar_join.note: war is the player's own SIDE of eWAR: batting on the batter board, pitching on the starter board. A row the eWAR artifact does not cover carries no value, and a board the artifact barely covers is refused whole rather than part stamped.

ewar_vintage.note: data/ewar.json rebuilds its live season nightly; completed seasons are frozen byte for byte and re-priced only by a hand build with the runbook cascade.

team_basis.label: leverage
team_basis.note: The club MLB's transaction feed lists today, on the charts and in team totals, so a traded player's whole season counts for his new club. Rows with no club (0) are left out of team totals.

note: Realized in-game leverage impact, computed from the MLB StatsAPI winProbability feed (FanGraphs blocks automated pulls). Batters: WPA, pLI (average Leverage Index faced), Clutch (WPA/pLI minus WPA/LI). Starters: per-start WPA and WPA/LI. Descriptive, not predictive.
